Name: Workout Songs
Description: Songs that get you moving, motivated, or ready to conquer a workout, whether it's the gym, a run, or just powering through the day.

Name: Groups Only
Description: Submit a song performed by a group, band, duo, or any act with two or more members. No solo artists.

Name: Songs with Featured Artists
Description: Pick a song that officially includes a featured artist. Bonus points if the collaboration elevates the track or the featured artist stole the show.

Name: Best Cover Songs
Description: A song originally recorded by one artist, performed by another. Share your favorite reinterpretation.
